meta.title: Foster a cat
meta.description: Foster a cat with Happy Paws and give a rescue cat a safe, loving place while they wait for a home.

s1.p: Fostering is the vital stepping stone in our work. It gives our cats the chance to feel safe during what can be a very stressful time for them.
s1.p2: Cats are sensitive creatures and not all settle in the rescue. Foster homes, where they can stay until they find their forever homes, are so important.
s1.alt: A brown tabby cat with folded ears and closed eyes, resting against a white cushion

s2.p: You give a cat a safe, calm place to be themselves while we find their forever home. We are with you at every step.

list.dd: [A few weeks to a few months: confirm]
[Food, litter, vet care and support: confirm]

s3.quote: “The care that the cats have had with their fosterer before reaching us has been super and we were spoilt by regular photos and videos.”

s4.p: If you would like to help us by fostering, please fill in our application. We would love to talk to you.
s4.p2: Would you rather talk first? [Get in touch](/contact/).
s4.text: You tell us a little about your home.
s4.text2: We chat, and [describe the home visit or check].
s4.text3: You meet your first foster cat.
